ev.q: Overall, 20.4% of adults aged > 18 years had five or more alcoholic drinks in 1 day at least once in the preceding year.
SOURCE: Heyman KM, Schiller JS, Barnes P. Early release of selected estimates based on data from the 2007 National Health Interview Survey.
Estimates are based on household interviews of a sample of the civilian noninstitutionalized U.S. population.
